# cloudxino_reserved_ip_assignment (Resource)

Points a `cloudxino_reserved_ip` at a CC2 server. Kept apart from the reserved IP so the address stays the team's when the server is replaced: the assignment moves to the new server. Destroying it unassigns the address (the reserved IP itself stays).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep the address when the server is replaced: the reserved IP has no server_id, and the
# assignment moves to the new server.
resource "cloudxino_reserved_ip" "web" {
  region = "dhaka-1"
}

resource "cloudxino_reserved_ip_assignment" "web" {
  reserved_ip_id = cloudxino_reserved_ip.web.id
  server_id      = cloudxino_server.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reserved_ip_id` (String) ID of the `cloudxino_reserved_ip`.
- `server_id` (String) ID of a `cloudxino_server` in the reserved IP's region. Changing it moves the address without a gap.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The reserved IP's ID.
- `ip_address` (String) The reserved address.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# the ID is the reserved IP's ID
terraform import cloudxino_reserved_ip_assignment.web <reserved_ip_id>
```
